Title: Spatial geometry in Azure Cosmos DB now generally available

Body.Content: Support for spatial geometry in Azure Cosmos DB is now generally available. Store both spatial geometry and geography data in Azure Cosmos DB with this capability. The geometry type represents data in a Euclidean (flat) coordinate system. All existing spatial system functions work with either the geography or geometry type.
